def sampler.qm31_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let digits ← sampler.qm31_digits block
  let i ← Array.index_usize digits 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize digits 1#usize
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i i1
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize digits 2#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize digits 3#usize
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i2 i3
  ok { c0 := c, c1 }

      Std.U32) iter

def
  sampler.low_base_p_digits.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32.call_mut
  (c : sampler.low_base_p_digits.closure) (tupled_args : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Std.U32 × sampler.low_base_p_digits.closure)
  := do
  let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize tupled_args)
  let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize tupled_args)
  let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i1 4#usize)
  let s ←
    core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) c
      { start := i, «end» := i2 }
  let r ←
    core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from 4#usize core.marker.CopyU8 s
  let a ← core.result.Result.unwrap core.fmt.DebugTryFromSliceError r
  let i3 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes a)
  ok (i3, c)

def sampler.low_base_p_digits
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  let quotient ←
    core.array.from_fn 8#usize
      sampler.low_base_p_digits.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32
      block
  let (digits, c) ←
    core.array.from_fn 8#usize
      sampler.low_base_p_digits.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32
      quotient
  let i ← Array.index_usize c 0#usize
  ok (digits, i)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::decode8]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 75:0-86:1 -/
def sampler.decode8
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize digits 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize digits 1#usize
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i i1
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize digits 2#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize digits 3#usize
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i2 i3
  let i4 ← Array.index_usize digits 4#usize
  let i5 ← Array.index_usize digits 5#usize
  let c2 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i4 i5
  let i6 ← Array.index_usize digits 6#usize
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize digits 7#usize
  let c3 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i6 i7
  aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.new { c0 := c, c1 }
    { c0 := c2, c1 := c3 }

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 91:4-95:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32) ×
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32) ×
    Std.U32) (Std.U32 × (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 →
    core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)))
  := do
  let (o, iter1, next_back) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done (addend, fun im => let im1 := next_back im none
                                        back im1))
  | some digit =>
    let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from digit)
    let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from addend)
    let sum ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i i1)
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i3 ← sum % i2
    let digit1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i3)
    let i4 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i5 ← sum / i4
    let addend1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i5)
    ok (cont (iter1, fun im => let im1 := next_back im (some digit1)
                               back im1, addend1))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 91:4-95:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def sampler.add_small_base_p_loop
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (Std.U32 × (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 →
    core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32))
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, back1, addend1) => sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body iter1
      back1 addend1)
    (iter, back, addend)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::add_small_base_p]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 90:0-98:1 -/
def sampler.add_small_base_p
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (Bool × (Array Std.U32 8#usize))
  := do
  let (iter, into_iter_back) ←
    MutAArray.Insts.CoreIterTraitsCollectIntoIteratorMutATIterMut.into_iter
      digits
  let (addend1, back) ←
    sampler.add_small_base_p_loop iter (fun im => im) addend
  let digits1 := into_iter_back back
  ok (addend1 != 0#u32, digits1)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::ordinary_sample]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 102:0-105:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sampler.ordinary_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let (digits, _) ← sampler.low_base_p_digits block
  sampler.decode8 digits

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::gamma_sample]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 111:0-119:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sampler.gamma_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let (digits, quotient) ← sampler.low_base_p_digits block
  let i ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_add quotient 1#u32)
  let (wrapped, digits1) ← sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
  let digits2 ←
    if wrapped
    then
      do
      let (_, digits3) ← sampler.add_small_base_p digits1 1#u32
      ok digits3
    else ok digits1
  sampler.decode8 digits2

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::Transcript<H>}::absorb]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 204:4-206:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.owned21.Transcript.absorb
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.owned21.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (payload : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (transcript.owned21.Transcript H)
  := do
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self.state)
  let i ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add 160#u8 row)
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ 0#u8, i ]))
  let i1 := Slice.len payload
  let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i1)
  let a ← lift (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes i2)
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 4#usize [ s, s1, s2, payload ]))
  let a1 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self.hash s3
  ok { self with state := a1 }

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::Transcript<H>}::queries]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 225:4-269:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.owned21.Transcript.queries
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.owned21.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (payload : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result ((core.result.Result (Array Std.U32 22#usize) verifier.Error) ×
    (transcript.owned21.Transcript H))
  := do
  let self1 ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.absorb aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst self row
      payload
  let a := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
  let blocks := Array.repeat 8#usize a
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self1.state)
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s, s1 ]))
  let a1 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s2
  let (_, index_mut_back) ← Array.index_mut_usize blocks 0#usize
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice self1.state)
  let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s5 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s3, s4 ]))
  let a2 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s5
  let blocks1 := index_mut_back a2
  let state ← Array.index_usize blocks1 0#usize
  let s6 ← lift (Array.to_slice state)
  let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s8 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s6, s7 ]))
  let a3 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s8
  let blocks2 := index_mut_back a1
  let blocks3 ← Array.update blocks2 1#usize a3
  let s9 ← lift (Array.to_slice state)
  let s10 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s11 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s9, s10 ]))
  let a4 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s11
  let blocks4 ← Array.update blocks1 1#usize a4
  let state1 ← Array.index_usize blocks4 1#usize
  let s12 ← lift (Array.to_slice state1)
  let s13 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s14 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s12, s13 ]))
  let a5 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s14
  let blocks5 ← Array.update blocks3 2#usize a5
  let s15 ← lift (Array.to_slice state1)
  let s16 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s17 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s15, s16 ]))
  let a6 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s17
  let blocks6 ← Array.update blocks4 2#usize a6
  let state2 ← Array.index_usize blocks6 2#usize
  let s18 ← lift (Array.to_slice state2)
  let s19 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s20 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s18, s19 ]))
  let a7 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s20
  let blocks7 ← Array.update blocks5 3#usize a7
  let s21 ← lift (Array.to_slice state2)
  let s22 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s23 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s21, s22 ]))
  let a8 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s23
  let blocks8 ← Array.update blocks6 3#usize a8
  let state3 ← Array.index_usize blocks8 3#usize
  let s24 ← lift (Array.to_slice state3)
  let s25 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s26 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s24, s25 ]))
  let a9 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s26
  let blocks9 ← Array.update blocks7 4#usize a9
  let s27 ← lift (Array.to_slice state3)
  let s28 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s29 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s27, s28 ]))
  let a10 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s29
  let blocks10 ← Array.update blocks8 4#usize a10
  let state4 ← Array.index_usize blocks10 4#usize
  let s30 ← lift (Array.to_slice state4)
  let s31 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s32 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s30, s31 ]))
  let a11 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s32
  let blocks11 ← Array.update blocks9 5#usize a11
  let s33 ← lift (Array.to_slice state4)
  let s34 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s35 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s33, s34 ]))
  let a12 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s35
  let blocks12 ← Array.update blocks10 5#usize a12
  let state5 ← Array.index_usize blocks12 5#usize
  let s36 ← lift (Array.to_slice state5)
  let s37 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s38 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s36, s37 ]))
  let a13 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s38
  let blocks13 ← Array.update blocks11 6#usize a13
  let s39 ← lift (Array.to_slice state5)
  let s40 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s41 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s39, s40 ]))
  let a14 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s41
  let blocks14 ← Array.update blocks12 6#usize a14
  let state6 ← Array.index_usize blocks14 6#usize
  let s42 ← lift (Array.to_slice state6)
  let s43 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s44 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s42, s43 ]))
  let a15 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s44
  let blocks15 ← Array.update blocks13 7#usize a15
  let s45 ← lift (Array.to_slice state6)
  let s46 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s47 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s45, s46 ]))
  let a16 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s47
  let blocks16 ← Array.update blocks14 7#usize a16
  let _ ← Array.index_usize blocks16 7#usize
  let r ← aspis_core.r0_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks15 blocks16
  let r1 ←
    core.result.Result.map_err
      (transcript.owned21.Transcript.queries.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleQuerySampleErrorError
      aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst) r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let (q, state7) := val
    let u ← Array.index_usize q 0#usize
    let we ←
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31
        u
    let a17 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes we
    let v ← alloc.vec.Vec.push self1.trace (5#u16, 0#usize, a17)
    let u1 ← Array.index_usize q 1#usize
    let we1 ←
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31
        u1
    let a18 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes we1
    let v1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push v (5#u16, 1#usize, a18)
    let u2 ← Array.index_usize q 2#usize
    let we2 ←
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31
        u2
    let a19 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes we2
    let v2 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push v1 (5#u16, 2#usize, a19)
    let u3 ← Array.index_usize q 3#usize
    let we3 ←
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31
        u3
    let a20 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes we3
    let v3 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push v2 (5#u16, 3#usize, a20)
    let u4 ← Array.index_usize q 4#usize
    let we4 ←
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31
        u4
    let a21 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes we4
    let v4 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push v3 (5#u16, 4#usize, a21)
    let u5 ← Array.index_usize q 5#usize
    let we5 ←
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31
        u5
    let a22 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes we5
    let v5 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push v4 (5#u16, 5#usize, a22)
    let u6 ← Array.index_usize q 6#usize
    let we6 ←

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::Transcript<H>}::block]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 207:4-212:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.owned21.Transcript.block
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.owned21.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (payload : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result ((Array Std.U8 32#usize) × (transcript.owned21.Transcript H))
  := do
  let self1 ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.absorb aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst self row
      payload
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self1.state)
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s, s1 ]))
  let block ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s2
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice self1.state)
  let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s5 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s3, s4 ]))
  let a ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s5
  ok (block, { self1 with state := a })

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::Transcript<H>}::scalar_k]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 221:4-224:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.owned21.Transcript.scalar_k
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.owned21.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (payload : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (aspis_core.field.QM31 × (transcript.owned21.Transcript H))
  := do
  let (a, self1) ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.block aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst self row
      payload
  let out ← sampler.qm31_sample a
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize row)
  let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_qm31 out
  let a1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes we
  let v ← alloc.vec.Vec.push self1.trace (4#u16, i, a1)
  ok (out, { self1 with trace := v })

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::Transcript<H>}::scalar]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 213:4-217:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.owned21.Transcript.scalar
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.owned21.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (payload : Slice Std.U8) (nonzero : Bool) :
  Result (aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact ×
    (transcript.owned21.Transcript H))
  := do
  let (block, self1) ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.block aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst self row
      payload
  let out ←
    if nonzero
    then sampler.gamma_sample block
    else sampler.ordinary_sample block
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize row)
  let a ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes out
  let v ← alloc.vec.Vec.push self1.trace (4#u16, i, a)
  ok (out, { self1 with trace := v })

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::Variant}::tag]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transport.rs', lines 6:4-6:80
    Visibility: public -/
def transport.Variant.tag (self : transport.Variant) : Result Std.U8 := do
  match self with
  | transport.Variant.S1 => ok 1#u8
  | transport.Variant.S2 => ok 2#u8
  | transport.Variant.D => ok 3#u8

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::owned21::Transcript<H>}::new]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 197:4-203:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.owned21.Transcript.new
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (semantic_state : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  (variant : transport.Variant) :
  Result (transcript.owned21.Transcript H)
  := do
  let domain ←
    lift (Array.to_slice
      (Array.make 29#usize [
        85#u8, 78#u8, 80#u8, 82#u8, 79#u8, 86#u8, 69#u8, 68#u8, 58#u8, 82#u8,
        49#u8, 58#u8, 80#u8, 82#u8, 73#u8, 86#u8, 65#u8, 84#u8, 69#u8, 45#u8,
        83#u8, 65#u8, 76#u8, 84#u8, 69#u8, 68#u8, 58#u8, 80#u8, 51#u8
        ]))
  let i ← transport.Variant.tag variant
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ i ]))
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice semantic_state)
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ domain, s, s1 ]))
  let a ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest hash s2
  ok
    {
      state := a,
      hash,
      trace :=
        (alloc.vec.Vec.new (Std.U16 × Std.Usize × (Array Std.U8 32#usize)))
    }

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sim::tail_owned21]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sim.rs', lines 795:0-806:1 -/
def sim.tail_owned21
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (state : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  (sem : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 25#usize)
  (z : Array aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint 2#usize) (r : sim.Records)
  (variant : transport.Variant) :
  Result ((core.result.Result sim.Drawn verifier.Error) × (Array Std.U8
    32#usize) × (alloc.vec.Vec (Std.U16 × Std.Usize × (Array Std.U8
    32#usize))))
  := do
  let t ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.new aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash state
      variant
  let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref r.y1
  let (gamma, t1) ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t 27#u8 s
      true
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice r.inactive)
  let (kappa, t2) ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t1 28#u8
      s1 false
  let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref r.c0
  let (alpha0, t3) ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t2 29#u8
      s2 false
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice r.folded_root)
  let payload ← alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 s3
  let s4 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref r.c1
  let payload1 ←
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 payload s4
  let s5 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref payload1
  let (alpha1, t4) ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t3 30#u8
      s5 false
  let s6 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref r.fin
  let (r1, t5) ←
    transcript.owned21.Transcript.queries aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t4 31#u8
      s6
  match r1 with
  | core.result.Result.Ok q =>
    let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Std.Array.empty Std.U8))
    let (rho, t6) ←
      transcript.owned21.Transcript.scalar_k aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t5
        32#u8 s7
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok
      { sem, z, gamma, kappa, alpha0, alpha1, queries := q, rho }, t6.state,
      t6.trace)
  | core.result.Result.Err e =>
    ok (core.result.Result.Err e, t5.state, t5.trace)

end AspisR1SimTail21
